characters.name: Vikram 'Vicky' Thakur
characters.desc: Sanjauli ka mechanic. Baap ki garage sambhaalta hai, taxi bhi chala leta hai. Gusse mein tez, dil se seedha.

characters.name: Amma
characters.desc: Vicky ki maa. Sanjauli ki teen-manzila ke upar wale kamre mein. Sach sabse pehle wahi bolti hai.

characters.name: Nafisa Qureshi
characters.desc: 'Pahari Awaaz' ki reporter. Lakkar Bazaar ke upar ek-kamre ka daftar. Saboot maangti hai, kahani nahi.

characters.name: Chhotu
characters.desc: Jakhoo ki chadhai pe rehta hai. Bandaron se baat karta hai, aur poore Mall pe nazar rakhta hai.

characters.name: Gurmeet 'Guru' Singh
characters.desc: HRTC bus driver, 22 saal se. Har mod jaanta hai. Getaway ke liye isse behtar koi nahi.

characters.name: Devinder 'Rana Sahab' Rana
characters.desc: Hotel Deodar Palace ka maalik. Mall Road pe darbar lagta hai. Zameen, timber, tender - sab uska.

characters.name: Contractor Bali
characters.desc: Rana ka haath. Dhalli mein yard, cement aur sariya - aur bahut saara bina-kaagaz ka deodar.

characters.name: DSP Ahluwalia
characters.desc: Vardi mein Rana ka aadmi. FIR likhta hai to bhi Rana ke ishaare pe.
